title: The Home Comfort Financing Payoff Figure
content:
## Definition

**Payoff figure.** The payoff figure on a Home Comfort Financing account is the account balance on the day of payoff plus the payoff per-diem interest, rounded to the cent half up only at the end.

**Payoff per-diem interest.** The payoff principal, multiplied by the payoff per-diem rate and by the number of payoff per-diem days, divided by 100 and by 365.

**Payoff principal.** The account balance less every late fee, returned-payment fee and interest charge posted less than one whole month before the day of payoff, and never below zero.

**Payoff per-diem rate.** The plan's APR.

**Payoff per-diem days.** From the day after the most recent payment through the day of payoff, or from the funded date through the day of payoff when no payment has posted.

## How the figure is built

| Element | Read from | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Account balance on the day of payoff | the account record | taken whole, every posted charge included |
| Recent fees and interest | late fee, returned-payment fee and interest lines posted less than one whole month before the day of payoff | taken off the balance to give the payoff principal (never below zero) |
| Per-diem rate | the plan's APR | used unrounded |
| Per-diem days | the most recent payment's posting date, or the funded date | day count as defined above |
| Payoff figure | balance plus per-diem interest | rounded to the cent half up, once |

The per-diem interest is worked on the payoff principal, but it is added to the full balance: fees and interest posted in the last month are paid off with the balance, and only the per-diem interest is measured without them.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Day of payoff 1 October; most recent payment posted 12 September; plan APR 7.99 percent. The balance on 1 October is $4210.37, which includes a $25.00 late fee and a $31.12 interest charge posted in the last month.

- Payoff principal: $4210.37 less $25.00 less $31.12, that is $4154.25.
- Per-diem days: 13 September through 1 October, both included: 19 days.
- Per-diem interest: $4154.25 multiplied by 7.99 and by 19, divided by 100 and by 365: $17.2782…
- Payoff figure: $4210.37 plus $17.2782…, that is $4227.6482…, rounded half up: $4227.65.

*No payment yet.* An account funded on 20 August with no payment posted, paid off on 1 October: the per-diem days run from 20 August through 1 October, both included, 43 days.
